errors.text: The proposed DFT-SQS/CALPHAD intervention does not reconstruct the central MTP-plus-FEP methodology or the replacement of EAM-based thermodynamic integration.

No rigorous method is specified for sampling the high-temperature liquid or calculating its absolute free energy; a lattice-distortion correction transferred from the solid is not a physically defined liquid free-energy model.
The hypothesis treats sluggish diffusion as an equilibrium stabilization mechanism, although diffusion kinetics do not directly lower the equilibrium Gibbs free energy.
The cited evidence concerns mechanical deformation of NbTaTiV and provides no evidence for melting temperature, fusion entropy, heat capacity, liquid modeling, or the claimed numerical accuracy.
Quantitative predictions such as ±50 K accuracy and 12–14 J/mol·K fusion entropy are unsupported by either calculations or relevant prior evidence.
